working_title: Build a Backup Water Plan — Keep Water Flowing When the Main Source Fails

owner_input.idea: Opportunity Intelligence spin-off: build a practical household backup-water plan before a well, pump, utility, storm, contamination event, or other primary-source failure occurs.
owner_input.owner_notes: Process strong spin-off opportunities through the normal Research gate. Preserve Water Through the Layers at Product/Visual work; do not reopen its approved research foundation.
owner_input.requested_angle: Responsible Rebellion: resilience through source diversity, stored known-safe water, function-before-form, practical fallback routes, testing/verification where it changes the decision, and no unsupported emergency-treatment claims.

websites_reviewed: https://academy.rebelranchministries.org (direct crawler returned an internal fetch error; current GitHub Program Hub source reviewed as the Academy source of truth)
audiences_identified: homeschool families studying preparedness, systems and resource planning
context_review.learning_area_reason: The core skill is household capability: identify dependency, size critical needs, build redundancy, choose safe fallback routes and verify recovery. It naturally connects to Sustainability & Agriculture but is broader than a water-treatment lesson.

conflicts_found: Emergency quantity guidance uses different planning scopes: CDC uses at least 1 gallon per person per day for a 3-day household supply and suggests 2 weeks if possible; Florida emergency planning materials commonly use 3-7 days; WHO/Sphere humanitarian standards discuss larger total domestic-use quantities around 15 L/person/day. These are context/scope differences, not one universal number.

Boiling/disinfection can address microbial risk but cannot make water contaminated with fuels, toxic chemicals, salts or many other chemicals safe; source type and advisory/test information can change the correct fallback route.
unresolved_questions: Product-stage market research on existing household water-plan tools and comparable products
Product-stage calculators for household, pet, livestock and sanitation quantities by scenario
Product-stage local-source mapping workflow and printable/interactive format
Product-stage cost comparisons for stored water, cisterns, generator-backed wells and other resilience upgrades
